error.description: The error associated with the #source that failed

targetType.description:
The target type for which this error occurred for this source.
one source per error will be generated for each target type.

transformName.description:
The transform type for which this error occurred for this source.
one source per error will be generated for each transform.

offsetInParentSources.description:
Record number of this failed record in the given content
For global exceptions, the recordNumber would be reported as -1
